question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The ________ of the whale is 2 tonnes.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"weight"** refers to the measure of how heavy an object is. (वजन)

 
 
• **Example:** The **weight** of the package was more than expected.
 
 
 
• **"weight"** is the correct term to describe the heaviness or mass of the whale. (वजन)
 
 
• **Example:** The **weight** of the whale is 2 tonnes.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Vet** (पशु चिकित्सक): A veterinarian or animal doctor.

 
 
• **Example:** The vet examined the injured dog carefully.
 
 
 
• **Wet** (गीला): Covered or saturated with water or another liquid.
 
 
• **Example:** His clothes were wet after the sudden rain.
 
 
 
• **Wait** (प्रतीक्षा): The action of staying where one is or delaying action until a particular time or event.
 
 
• **Example:** Please wait here until I come back.
